subject: Demo recap & proposed trial kickoff — Syndicate Systems
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Santiago Ortiz <santiago.ortiz@syndicatesystems.com>, Elena Marin <elena.marin@syndicatesystems.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap & proposed trial kickoff — Syndicate Systems

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and a proposed trial (POC) plan so we can align next steps and owners. Happy to adjust based on your procurement/security timelines.

Call highlights:
- Primary objective: reduce false positives in claims routing and surface the top-3 recommended action with confidence scores to agents.
- Expected load for pilot: 1200–2k inference requests/day, 95th p95 latency target <= 400ms for single-turn RT usage.
- Success will be measured by precision lift on top-1 recommendation (target +12 points vs baseline) and no production-impacting latency regressions.

Proposed 2-week pilot (outline):
1) Week 0 (prep, targeted by you): share a small sample (2k anonymized records) and a short list of acceptance queries.
2) Week 1 (integration & smoke): connector + sample ingestion, baseline runs, basic latency/throughput profiling.
3) Week 2 (evaluation & handoff): run evaluation suite, review metrics, agree severity thresholds and next-phase ask.

Owners:
- Redwood AE: Tessa Morgan — program lead and contractual touchpoint.
- Redwood SE: Ben Carter — integration, test harness, on-call during run.
- Redwood CS: Monica Patel — success criteria, adoption playbook.
- Syndicate: Santiago (engineering lead) and Elena (product).

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Santiago/Elena: confirm sample delivery window and any IP/data-handling constraints.
- Syndicate procurement: share SOW template or preferred contracting flow (we can provide standard trial SOW).
- Security: we can return an initial redwood security questionnaire; happy to push SOC2 docs and a short architecture diagram.

Attachments: attached a short POC scope workbook that maps success metrics to test cases (syndicate_poc_scope.xlsx) and our Pilot Playbook (redwood_pilot_playbook.pdf).

Proposed kickoff window: Sep 7 start (prep the week prior). If that doesn't work, propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

Thanks — I'll book a 30m kick-off once I get confirmation of the start date.

—
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Santiago Ortiz <santiago.ortiz@syndicatesystems.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Marin <elena.marin@syndicatesystems.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed trial kickoff — Syndicate Systems

Tessa — thanks for the clear summary. High level we are aligned and Sep 7 looks good from product/engineering perspective. A few clarifying points before we lock dates: 

- Success metrics: for our internal stakeholders we need the precision uplift on top-1 to be verified against a labeled holdout (we can provide labels for ~1k records). Also want a secondary metric around median confidence calibration (avoid overconfident low-quality outputs).
- Data residency: trial data must remain in our US region and be deleted after 30 days of trial end. Can you confirm Redwood's retention controls for trial artifacts?
- Security: we prefer to review an editable security questionnaire up front; SOC2 is standard for us — please share the latest report or point us to where we can download it.
- Pricing/SOW: procurement will want a simple trial SOW + a statement of what happens after successful pilot (pricing guidance or committed capacity options).

If you can confirm the data residency and share the editable questionnaire, we'll circulate internally and target Sep 7 prep.

Thanks — Santiago
Santiago Ortiz
Director, Product Engineering
Syndicate Systems
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Santiago Ortiz <santiago.ortiz@syndicatesystems.com>, Elena Marin <elena.marin@syndicatesystems.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed trial kickoff — Syndicate Systems

Hi Santiago / Elena — Ben here (SE). Quick answers and an evaluation plan sketch so your engineers know what to expect.

1) Data residency / retention:
- We can provision the trial to run in our US region and apply a 30-day post-trial automatic data purge for all trial artifacts. We'll capture that in the SOW.

2) Security artifacts:
- Attaching the editable security questionnaire you requested (security_questionnaire_v2.xlsx) and a link to our SOC2 report in a secure viewer.

3) Evaluation plan (technical):
- Test harness: we'll provide a lightweight runner (python) that accepts CSV payloads and emits per-request latency, tokens, and model-confidence.
- Baseline vs trial: you provide labeled holdout (~1k); we will run both baseline and Redwood inference to produce the precision lift report.
- Load profile: recommended burst of 10rps sustained for 30m to validate autoscaling; steady-state for day-to-day at 0.5–1.5 rps.
- Metrics we will capture: top-1 precision, top-3 recall, median and p95 latency, confidence calibration (ECE), token cost per inference.

4) Week-by-week run-of-show (detailed):
- Prep (week before start): sample anonymization checklist, API key exchange, drive folder for logs.
- Day 1 (integration): connector, smoke test, ping/health checks.
- Day 3–7 (baseline & runs): run baseline and Redwood runs, collect metrics and artifacts.
- Day 8–10 (analysis): produce report and walk-through.

Attachments included: security_questionnaire_v2.xlsx (editable), and a README for the test harness (we'll drop the repo link once kick-off is booked).

I can run a technical kickoff for 45m on Sep 8 (PST) — propose Sep 8 at 09:30 PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite with the repo link and initial test harness.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Marin <elena.marin@syndicatesystems.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Santiago Ortiz <santiago.ortiz@syndicatesystems.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed trial kickoff — Syndicate Systems

Thanks, all — appreciate the detail. Confirming:
- Sep 7 prep week is fine; target Sep 8 for the SE kickoff at 09:30 PT.
- We'll deliver the labeled holdout (1k) and the anonymized 2k sample by Aug 31.
- Procurement contact is procurement@sydsys.com — they'll expect a short SOW and acceptance criteria.
- We'll sign the data-retention clause (30 days) and expect SOC2 access.

I've attached the purchase-team contact card and will ask procurement to expect the SOW. Once we have the security questionnaire back filled, procurement will triage.

Elena
Elena Marin
Product Manager | Syndicate Systems
Attachments: procurement_contact_vcard.vcf
